entries.title: Narrator: "The sun was just beginning to rise..."
entries.dialogueText: The sun was just beginning to rise as Lucian, Petr and I gathered in my office to discuss the fallout of the Benfi Festival.

entries.dialogueText: "He acted like an ass, too. Maybe you can both come out of this looking good.”

entries.dialogueText: “Maybe. Or just get him to dig in harder.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“How should we proceed, sir?""
entries.dialogueText: “How should we proceed, sir?"

entries.dialogueText: "I'm still skeptical about this. But fine. I'll fetch Livia.”

entries.title: Player: "“Were you expecting me?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Were you expecting me?”
entries.menuText: “Were you expecting me to?”

entries.dialogueText: “It was a mistake. A grave one at that.”

entries.dialogueText: “Let's see how you like the press hearing about the loss of Anrica to the National Front.”

entries.dialogueText: “You piece of shit!”
entries.menuText: “You piece of shit!”

entries.dialogueText: “You just made a very powerful enemy. Don't forget that.”
entries.menuText: “You just made a very powerful enemy.”

entries.speaker: Curtan Leste
entries.title: Curtan Leste: "“You seem to be surrounded by more..."
entries.dialogueText: “You seem to be surrounded by more and more enemies these days, Mr. President.”

entries.dialogueText: Curtan Leste hung up the phone.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“That's going to have consequences...."
entries.dialogueText: “That's going to have consequences. Is there anything else we can do?”

entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“That went worse than expected. We'..."
entries.dialogueText: “That went worse than expected. We've lost the chance to control the narrative, and we've lost a city to another party.”

entries.title: Curtan Leste: "“That depends on you.”"
entries.dialogueText: “That depends on you.”

entries.speaker: Curtan Leste
entries.title: Curtan Leste: "“Here is my demand.”"

entries.speaker: Curtan Leste
entries.title: Curtan Leste: "“The First Lady won't be allowed to..."
entries.dialogueText: “The First Lady won't be allowed to meddle in politics from now on. No meetings. No advocating for her little causes. And certainly no speeches."

entries.speaker: Curtan Leste
entries.title: Curtan Leste: "“Should you fail to keep her from d..."
entries.dialogueText: “Should you fail to keep her from doing so, you can say your goodbyes to Anrica."

entries.title: Curtan Leste: ""On the other hand, if you do this,..."
entries.dialogueText: "On the other hand, if you do this, I will issue a full apology and your party will retain my support."

entries.speaker: Curtan Leste
entries.title: Curtan Leste: "“What will it be?”"
entries.dialogueText: “What will it be?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You leave me no choice. I'll tell..."
